title: Flynn AI-Agent Communication Workflows V2
purpose: Machine-executable gates, states, variants, stop conditions, humanization, release policy, and learning loop.

source_boundary.rule: Direct claims require a supplied-source locator. Applied records must identify themselves as extensions.

records.title: Core communication workflow
records.rule: Reason through the complete core sequence before releasing a message; drafting begins only after purpose, recipient, evidence, surface, and architecture are ready.
decision_logic: Run CONTEXT → PURPOSE → RECIPIENT → RECIPIENT_STATE_NEEDS → EVIDENCE → COMMUNICATION_SURFACE → MESSAGE_ARCHITECTURE → TONE → PROOF → ASK → RESPONSE_FRICTION → FOLLOW_UP → OUTCOME → LEARNING_LOOP.
At each gate, preserve unknowns and stop on a blocker.
guardrails: Do not expose the internal reasoning system in the final communication.
Do not mention AI assistance.
The sophistication belongs in reasoning; the simplicity belongs in the message.

records.title: Eighteen-question communication gate
records.rule: Answer all eighteen questions before finalization; unknown answers remain explicit and can block drafting when material.
decision_logic: Answer each question with evidence or UNKNOWN.
Block finalization on unresolved purpose, claim, ask, medium, or material risk.
Link other unknowns to a follow-up or qualification.
guardrails: Do not answer with generic adjectives.
Do not fabricate missing context.

records.title: Invisible reasoning, simple message
records.rule: Keep the reasoning system internal; output only the communication, necessary context, evidence, ask, and limitations appropriate to the recipient and surface.
decision_logic: Remove internal labels, scores, chain-of-thought, source-control mechanics, and AI-process commentary unless the user explicitly requests an audit artifact.
Retain only recipient-useful qualification and evidence.
guardrails: Do not mention AI assistance.
Do not expose hidden reasoning.
Do not remove material uncertainty or source attribution needed by the recipient.

stop_states.BLOCKED_PURPOSE: Purpose or success condition is materially undefined.
stop_states.BLOCKED_RECIPIENT: Recipient, authority, or required information cannot be established safely.
stop_states.BLOCKED_EVIDENCE: A consequential claim lacks support and cannot be removed or qualified.
stop_states.BLOCKED_MEDIUM: The selected surface cannot carry the required interaction, safety, or documentation.
stop_states.BLOCKED_RISK: The message creates unresolved trust, status, privacy, safety, legal, or relationship risk.
stop_states.READY_TO_RELEASE: All mandatory gates and Judge passes are complete.

output_policy: Do not expose the reasoning system.
Sophistication belongs in reasoning; simplicity belongs in the message.
